title: feat: add path parsing to BasicShape
author: noahbald
summary: Adds BasicShape::Path, parsed and optimized by the external crate oxvg_path 0.0.1-beta.4 (SVGO-style convertPathData), so `path("M 0 0 L 0 10")` -> `path("M0 0v10")`. Today path() passes through unchanged. Fully parsing path() fits the philosophy, but it brings in a beta third-party dependency whose types become part of the public AST, and the path rewriting runs at parse time even without minify.
evidence: master 574eee2 CLI (target/review/base-574eee2/lightningcss; master-build.log was still empty): `clip-path:path("M 0 0 L 0 10")` passes through unchanged (`.foo{clip-path:path("M 0 0 L 0 10")}`). The PR is a re-open of #824 (closed by the author only to move off their fork's master). Base 9e04c01 (2023): it predates the cssparser 0.37 upgrade and the Cargo.lock changes, so it's heavily bitrotted. oxvg_path::Path would be exposed in the serde/jsonschema AST (node/ast.d.ts). No maintainer comments in either PR.
decision: Do we want path() data parsed and rewritten via the external beta crate oxvg_path (exposed in the public AST), or should path() stay as a string until we have an in-tree parser?
